title: Subset selection for matrices by column exchange
summary: The paper considers the problem of finding a submatrix $X_{\mathcal{S}} \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times k}$ in a matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$, such that the spectral or Frobenius norm of $X_{\mathcal{S}}^† X$ is limited, which guarantees it provides a good representation of the whole matrix. Such bounds can be reached by applying greedy algorithms, maximizing the submatrix volume.
